description: Get live airport-level delay, cancellation, and weather flight-rules for one airport, plus tomorrow's forecast and departure outlook when one is published. Accepts IATA code, city, or airport name. Airport-level only, not flight-number tracking.

airport.description: Airport IATA code, city, or airport name. Examples: JFK, LHR, Copenhagen, Chicago O'Hare.

format.description: Output format. Use plain for SMS-style replies; markdown includes formatted links. Defaults to plain.

name: get_airport_delay_status

detailsUrl.description: Pro Flight Search airport details URL for citation or follow-up.

disclaimer.description: Operational-data disclaimer for the airport status.

scope.description: Current data scope for the tool result.

statusText.description: Airport status text returned in the MCP content block.

tomorrow.description: Tomorrow at this airport, on its local date, from the WeatherTomorrow feeds: forecast (high and low in °C with the likely range, chances 0 to 1, wind in kt), departure outlook (predicted percent of departures cancelled or leaving 60+ min late, against the airport's usual percent, with a level and the weather drivers) and source to credit, with any credit lines its data require (show them with the numbers). A forecast, never a measurement. Null when no fresh outlook exists; null never means normal.

title: Get airport delay status
